name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: One unframed disclosure: a caret box whose keyline runs down the panel as a spine; the panel unfolds.
whenToUse: Use it to hide less common settings or detail behind one disclosure. For several stacked sections use Accordion.

parts.name: CollapsiblePanel
parts.description: The panel (Base UI Collapsible.Panel). It unfolds; its content sits inside the clip, on the spine.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the content inside the panel's clip (its layout: `grid gap-4`).

parts.name: CollapsibleRoot
parts.description: One disclosure, unframed, for a form or a panel body ("Advanced options", "Show 12 more"). ⊟ Advanced options the trigger: a square caret box and the label The panel UNFOLDS from the trigger (160ms, folds in 120ms; instant under reduced motion). The spine is the same idea as the table detail's merged index cell: continuity drawn by a keyline, not a connector. Open state, keyboard, `aria-expanded` and find-in-page (`hiddenUntilFound`) are Base UI Collapsible's.

parts.name: CollapsibleTrigger
parts.description: The trigger (Base UI Collapsible.Trigger): the caret box, the label and the meta.

props.name: meta
props.description: Trailing text in the Code voice: a count of what is hidden ("12"), a short status.
